description: Phase 4: S-segment sidebar routing in resolveProcedureSheetKey.ts (Tasks 17-18). Adds the S-cycle if-chain block to the procedure sheet key resolver, following the established long-prefix-first pattern. Independent of FEAT-001/002 — this function is a pure routing utility.
steps: 1. Read context.json first. Then read audit-platform/frontend/src/utils/resolveProcedureSheetKey.ts in full (already confirmed ~95 lines). The function is a pure if-chain with startsWith checks. Currently has D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N segments but NO S segment.

2. Add S-segment block between the K segment (ending at K9→k9a, ~line 82) and the F segment (starting at F2→f2a, ~line 84). The S block must use long-prefix-first ordering to avoid startsWith mismatches. Exact entries per design §1.6: S20→s20a, S17→s17a, S16→e1a (fallback), S15→s15a, S14→s14a, S13→s13a, S12→s12a, S11→e1a (fallback), S10→s10a, S8→s8a, S1→s1a. Add Chinese comments for each entry matching the existing style. CRITICAL: S16 and S11 must appear before S1 to avoid being caught by startsWith('S1'). S8 naturally safe (doesn't start with S1) but placed before S1 for clarity.

3. Create test file audit-platform/frontend/src/utils/__tests__/resolveProcedureSheetKey.s-cycle.spec.ts following the pattern in resolveProcedureSheetKey.spec.ts (vitest describe/it blocks). Test cases: (a) S20/S20-1→s20a, (b) S17/S17-1/S17-2→s17a, (c) S16→e1a (explicit fallback), (d) S15→s15a, (e) S14→s14a, (f) S13→s13a, (g) S12→s12a, (h) S11/S11-1→e1a (explicit fallback, NOT caught by S1), (i) S10/S10-1→s10a, (j) S8/S8-1→s8a, (k) S1/S1-1→s1a, (l) S2→e1a (default fallback), (m) S9→e1a (default fallback), (n) S21→e1a (default fallback), (o) S32/S34→e1a (bundle codes fall to default).
4. Run the full resolveProcedureSheetKey test suite to ensure no regression in D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N segments.
acceptance_criteria: resolveProcedureSheetKey routes S20→s20a, S17→s17a, S15→s15a, S14→s14a, S13→s13a, S12→s12a, S10→s10a, S8→s8a, S1→s1a
S16→e1a and S11→e1a (explicit fallback, not caught by S1 prefix)
No regression in existing D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N routing tests
New S-cycle test file passes all cases
findings: All 117 tests passed (16 new S-cycle + 101 existing). S16/S11 correctly fallback to e1a without being caught by startsWith('S1'). No regressions in D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K/L/M/N segments.
